verdict.rationale: Missive ships rule-based workflow automation ("Automate your workflows", up to 1000 rules) that acts on its own, for example rules that create drafts and shared-account auto-archive, plus webhooks and an API. On the AI side, the changelog mentions letting an agent triage new conversations against your CRM and long assistant sessions that no longer need babysitting, but this agentic triage runs through external MCP-connected apps rather than a documented native background agent. missing for 10: documentation of rule triggers and actions, a native AI agent that runs autonomously on triggers or schedules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
